title: Historic Mill of Sanssouci
geometryBasis: The native windmill relation and its two nested octagons establish the position and plan. The association publishes gallery height and sail diameter.
sectionBasis: The original Qualla photograph shows an octagonal skirt, a raised gallery with timber brackets, dark shingled smock, a boat-shaped cap and four open lattice vanes.
limitations: The cap is shown in a representative parked orientation and the sails remain stationary.
Roof profiles, timber dimensions and rear enclosure details are estimated from the available photograph and mapped structures.
